scene: The glowing airship drops transport tokens across the rooftop edge.
picture: Flat side-view along the rooftop edge. On the far left stands an open metal freight lift cage. Left of centre, the curly-haired boy in a denim jacket catches a dropped token. On the right, a yellow tram waits on tracks. Far right, a wooden rowing boat bobs in a flooded canal drain.
shown: a metal freight lift shaft with open folding gate on the far left
a sleek yellow tram stopped at a suspended rooftop track on the right
a small wooden rowing boat resting in a rooftop canal pool on the far right
